connector.name: three.ws Audio
connector.registryDescription: Text-to-speech, speech-to-text, audio-to-face lipsync, and motion-capture clips for 3D agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package audio-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nirholas account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: THREE_WS_BASE
env.description: Base URL of the three.ws API that serves the audio/animation endpoints. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.

env.name: THREE_WS_API_KEY
env.description: Optional three.ws API key (bearer token). Raises the metered TTS/ASR/Audio2Face rate limits and unlocks your own private/unlisted motion-capture clips. Leave unset to use the public surface anonymously.

env.name: THREE_WS_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for the live audio/animation calls (synthesis and recognition are real upstream model calls).
